review_findings.finding: A per-table commit was treated too much like an arbitrary multi-entity transaction.
review_findings.resolution: Require a supported local atomic command path, including its receipt, and snapshot-consistent readers. A crash-repairable partial canonical operation does not pass.

review_findings.finding: Weighted scores could compensate for a correctness failure.
review_findings.resolution: Use pass/fail correctness gates first. Compare performance and integration complexity only among passing candidates.

review_findings.finding: Main-branch features, stable Rust APIs, and namespace/server APIs were conflated.
review_findings.resolution: Freeze release, feature set, source revision and local capability probes. A REST endpoint or format specification is not proof of embedded Rust support.

review_findings.finding: A revision field alone does not prevent lost updates; unique IDs are not enforced merely by index metadata.
review_findings.resolution: Atomically compare revisions and absent keys, validate affected rows, and commit all results or none. Test duplicate ID/edge insertion and absent-key races.

review_findings.finding: Session ownership was not defined across frontends, reconnects and subagents.
review_findings.resolution: Bind implicit legacy sessions to authenticated frontend channels. Never use a daemon-global current session. Shared-channel subagents require explicit native binding or are documented as one legacy session.

review_findings.finding: Retries, cancellation and lost responses had no durable operation contract.
review_findings.resolution: Store a scoped idempotency receipt with the canonical mutation; distinguish storage conflicts, stale user edits and unknown commit outcomes.

review_findings.finding: UUIDv7 IDs were implicitly being used as a safe ordered projection checkpoint.
review_findings.resolution: Use durable per-entity pending work and compare-and-clear acknowledgements. IDs are identities, not commit order.

review_findings.finding: Projection lag, stale results and missing embeddings were underspecified.
review_findings.resolution: Separate canonical durability, lexical freshness and semantic freshness; validate generation and document revision; never return an obsolete vector result as current.

review_findings.finding: The model loader contract was too generic.
review_findings.resolution: Validate a pinned model recipe: architecture plus tokenizer, attention masks, pooling, prefixes, normalization and artifacts. E5-small declares BertModel but XLMRobertaTokenizer.

review_findings.finding: One memory was assumed always to fit one embedding input.
review_findings.resolution: Preserve canonical memory identity but permit deterministic derived chunks; detect truncation and test queries whose answer lies beyond the first model window.

review_findings.finding: Raw RRF/priority values and unit-scale cosine were combined in MMR without calibration.
review_findings.resolution: Keep an upstream-reference scorer for tests, normalize native relevance explicitly, bound graph and priority contributions, and calibrate on a held-out corpus.

review_findings.finding: Graph integrity and the distinction between authoritative corrections and similarity bonuses were missing.
review_findings.resolution: Specify endpoint constraints, edge direction/symmetry, uniqueness, cycle policy and protected correction/conflict bundles.

review_findings.finding: Filters could be applied only after retrieval or lost during graph expansion.
review_findings.resolution: Apply one effective scope to every retrieval leg and graph step; enforce current eligibility on hydration and backfill filtered candidates without silently claiming completeness.

review_findings.finding: There was no no-answer policy or exact-identifier retrieval contract.
review_findings.resolution: Test empty/no-match queries, identifier-preserving tokenization and semantic false positives; never interpret nearest-neighbor rank as proof of relevance.

review_findings.finding: Full compatibility was stated before actual wire and behavioral baselines existed.
review_findings.resolution: Freeze Lemma 0.21.0 by commit; capture tools, handlers, instructions, side effects, CLI and skill artifacts; maintain an explicit enhancement/deviation ledger.

review_findings.finding: The proposed domain and importer omitted nullable fields, evidence, archives and parts of guide/session history.
review_findings.resolution: Use a complete field inventory and loss-accounted import; preserve unknown legacy fields and external IDs; do not coerce unknown quality to zero.

review_findings.finding: Batching visible access counters/confidence can change Lemma behavior.
review_findings.resolution: Persist contract-visible read side effects before success; batch only semantically equivalent groups or explicitly lossy diagnostic telemetry.

review_findings.finding: Durable-write latency excluded the cost that defines durability, and SIGKILL was overinterpreted.
review_findings.resolution: Include the durability barrier in ACK latency. Separate process-crash, storage-fault and modeled power-loss evidence.

review_findings.finding: Backup/restore lacked a complete consistent-cut and publication protocol.
review_findings.resolution: Snapshot all canonical state; bind confirmation to digest, store generation and state; stage, validate and atomically publish a restored generation.

review_findings.finding: Local IPC, path safety and query construction lacked a trust model.
review_findings.resolution: Use same-user authenticated IPC, private directories, an OS singleton lock, bounded framing, safe path opens and typed predicates.

review_findings.finding: Secret detection and Rust purity were described as absolutes.
review_findings.resolution: State bounded detection guarantees; audit feature-resolved native dependencies and model licenses; separate release runtime from test/import tooling.

review_findings.finding: Concurrent sessions had no queue, resource or fairness policy.
review_findings.resolution: Bound in-flight work and inference batches; reserve interactive capacity; define overload, cancellation and maintenance behavior.

review_findings.finding: Benchmarks lacked fair durability, arrival models, maintenance and confidence intervals.
review_findings.resolution: Use identical traces and durability; separate embeddings; measure queue time, tails, retries, lag and storage growth at steady state.

review_findings.finding: GraphRAG was required to beat every baseline without defined labels or statistical criteria.
review_findings.resolution: Require no regression on protected cases and evaluate quality at a fixed context budget on frozen held-out labels. Improvements are empirical, not guaranteed.

review_findings.finding: Skill installation was confused with client discovery and reliable activation.
review_findings.resolution: Test installer ownership separately from each host client; preserve foreign files and do not claim installation forces an agent workflow.

review_findings.finding: Importing a live SQLite database read-only was treated as sufficient isolation.
review_findings.resolution: Read a supported coherent snapshot, accounting for WAL and sidecar state, and prove the original source is unchanged.

review_findings.finding: Horizontal phases deferred conformance, recovery and user-visible validation.
review_findings.resolution: Build vertical slices with tests in each slice; freeze the contract first and prove atomicity before implementing the large tool surface.

review_findings.finding: The plan did not distinguish design decisions, verified facts, hypotheses and executed evidence.
review_findings.resolution: Every requirement has an owner work package, tests and an evidence status. This pack is a reviewed specification, not a tested implementation.

requirements.title: Atomic domain commands
requirements.contract: A supported multi-entity mutation and its deduplication receipt publish atomically; canonical readers cannot see a partial operation.
requirements.evidence: fjall_backend: fjall_atomic_merge_no_partial_state, fjall_kill_reopen_durability_syncall; lance_backend: stepwise_merge_exposes_partial_publication_boundary, test_kill_and_reopen_durability; domain interpreter serial-history oracle; canonical merge records result pending + source tombstone jobs atomically with the mutation (§5.3 write set, merge_enqueues_jobs_and_dirties_pipeline)

requirements.title: Hard decision gates
requirements.contract: A candidate failing correctness, offline packaging or license gates is ineligible regardless of throughput.
requirements.evidence: AD-01 decided Option B (Fjall + Lance) from WP-02 hard gates; see plans/AD-01_canonical_backend.md

requirements.title: Pinned capabilities
requirements.contract: All adopted dependency features are identified by exact release/source and exercised through the selected local Rust API.
requirements.evidence: WP-00 baseline: pinned manifest, resolved dependency set (cargo check OK), local Rust API exercised in storage probes

requirements.title: Revision and uniqueness enforcement
requirements.contract: Conditional updates, create-if-absent, edge uniqueness and typed alias allocation are atomic under concurrency.
requirements.evidence: CanonicalRepository: one_winner_for_concurrent_absent_key (T-CONC-02), stale_revision_conflict_is_not_blindly_rebased, supersession_cycle_rejected_concurrency_safely, concurrent_opposite_supersession_edges_keep_graph_acyclic (Barrier(2) A→B ∥ B→A, exactly one winner via SSI predicate + retry), uniqueness invariants. T-CONC-01 disjoint-field races and the remaining T-GRAPH-01 race matrix (endpoint deletion vs edge creation) deferred.

requirements.title: Session isolation
requirements.contract: Every call has a stable frontend channel and authorized session context; legacy implicit session state never crosses channels.
requirements.evidence: WP-04: registry per-(frontend,channel) session binding, no daemon-global session, lease expiry. WP-09: session_start/attempt/end route by (frontend,channel) via registry; session_end_is_retry_safe_no_double_count proves a retried end is rejected before guide evaluation. IPC layer binds every frame to the handshake identity (frontend_mismatch rejection, mismatched_frame_frontend_rejected). T-SESS-01 (32-channel interleave with colliding MCP request IDs) and T-SESS-02 (reconnect/lease/restart/subagent) still deferred to a dedicated concurrency test.

requirements.title: Retry-safe effects
requirements.contract: Retried logical commands within the documented replay window have one canonical effect; ambiguous outcomes are not blindly replayed as new work.
requirements.evidence: CanonicalRepository: idempotent_replay_returns_recorded_receipt, key_reuse_with_different_input_is_error, unknown-outcome resolution via receipt. Fixed-expiry retry namespaces (24h TTL, issue_namespace) + gc_expired + handshake issuance implemented with tests (namespace expiry/GC, frontend-scoped GC); periodic background GC scheduling + T-CONC-03/T-REC-02 full race matrix still deferred.

requirements.title: Projection convergence
requirements.contract: Pending work is durable, versioned and acknowledged only by compare-and-clear after projection publication.
requirements.evidence: T-PROJ-01 (kill between commit and ack keeps newer work pending, replay idempotent), T-PROJ-02 (stale publication refused after generation change) pass. Blue-green lifecycle: stage/note/activate/abandon with single-transaction pointer flip (cutover_is_atomic_and_requires_readiness), stale-watermark refusal, rollback, interrupted-build resolution, idempotent re-activation, build-dirty gate (mid-build writes block activation until re-note), generation reaper (expiry-gated). Full process-crash matrices and multi-frontend convergence runs deferred.

requirements.title: Freshness contracts
requirements.contract: Direct reads observe acknowledged writes; search never silently represents stale revisions or unavailable embeddings as complete current semantic results.
requirements.evidence: T-PROJ-03 (stalled embedder keeps lexical + direct reads, semantic stays pending) and T-SEARCH-01 (empty/unbuilt/null/concurrent optimization) pass. Split lexical/semantic readiness, no-answer rules, empty-backend fallbacks (recall_browse, semantic_search) and per-request active-generation resolution covered. Soak and multi-client freshness runs deferred.

requirements.title: Model correctness
requirements.contract: The selected Candle adapter matches a pinned reference recipe within documented numerical and retrieval tolerances.
requirements.evidence: Recipe validation (BertModel + XLMRobertaTokenizer, unsupported-recipe rejection), tokenizer/prefix checks, reference-vector equivalence (cosine >= 0.999, abs <= 1e-3 — proposed 0.99999/1e-4 thresholds were loosened with rationale, not measurements), projector/query bridges with role-equivalence + prefix-asymmetry tests. Weight-gated tests execute where artifacts are present and SKIP otherwise; GPU/mixed-precision profile deferred.

requirements.title: Long-memory handling
requirements.contract: Long input produces explicit bounded chunking or a visible coverage limitation, never silent semantic loss.

requirements.title: Calibrated ranking
requirements.contract: Native score components share a documented scale; legacy scoring and enhanced scoring have separate evidence.
requirements.evidence: src/retrieval/ranking.rs: rrf_hand_computed_one_based, normalize_rrf_max_maps_to_one, legacy_reference_score_scale_documented, native_score_bounded_and_calibrated (separate legacy vs native evidence); mmr.rs: mmr_prefers_relevance_with_diversity_penalty

requirements.title: Graph semantics
requirements.contract: Graph mutations enforce endpoint/direction/uniqueness/cycle policy, and retrieval preserves corrections and unresolved conflicts.
requirements.evidence: Mutation side (WP-03): endpoint existence, edge uniqueness, self-supersession and cycle rejection enforced in-transaction (supersession_cycle_rejected_concurrency_safely, concurrent_opposite_supersession_edges_keep_graph_acyclic). Retrieval side (WP-07): T-GRAPH-02/T-RANK-03 covered by conflict_bundle_preserves_both_sides, superseded_memory_excluded_current_protected, stale_only_recall_redirects_to_current, scope_applies_to_all_legs_and_graph. T-GRAPH-01 full concurrent race matrix (endpoint deletion vs edge creation races) still deferred.

requirements.title: Scope enforcement
requirements.contract: Scope, lifecycle, date/type filters and confidence eligibility apply to lexical, dense, graph, direct reads and generated context.
requirements.evidence: src/retrieval/scope.rs: EffectiveScope resolved once, applied to legs (to_lance_filter), hydration and every graph step; engine.rs: scope_applies_to_all_legs_and_graph (T-SCOPE-01), min_confidence_backfilled_from_canonical (T-SCOPE-02), date filters, direct-ID scope enforcement

requirements.title: Relevance and abstention
requirements.contract: Exact identifiers remain retrievable; no-match queries may return no applicable memory; zero scores and NaNs do not enter rank fusion.
requirements.evidence: engine.rs: exact_identifiers_survive_lexical_leg, french_accents_and_mixed_case_survive, underscores_and_paths_preserved (T-SEARCH-02); no_answer_when_nothing_matches, dense_no_answer_threshold_filters_noise (T-RANK-04); ranking.rs: rrf/normalize/native/cosine reject non-finite, cosine_handles_missing_and_zero_vectors

requirements.title: Complete compatibility surface
requirements.contract: Every pinned Lemma tool, schema, behavior, instruction path, command and applicable skill contract is tested or explicitly marked as a named deviation.
requirements.evidence: T-MCP-01: mcp.rs served_tools_match_frozen_schema (26 tools, verbatim baseline). T-MCP-02: tools.rs behavioral tests + 2 differential wire tests (byte-for-byte vs upstream) + stats/audit golden regression pins (honestly labeled, not upstream oracles) + error-envelope tests. T-MCP-03: mcp.rs typed routing + validation tests. T-MCP-04: read/feedback/session side-effect tests (see RQ-17). WP-09: 15 tools with behavioral tests incl. session_stats backing (empty/active/completed). T-CLI-01 deferred to WP-10 (CLI). Differential replay for the 15 WP-09 tools deferred (behavioral tests encode the contract instead).

requirements.title: Loss-accounted data model
requirements.contract: Known fields, nullability, evidence, archives, guide dependencies and legacy history survive serialization and interchange.
requirements.evidence: T-DATA-01: domain model + serialization round-trip (domain tests pass). T-IMPORT-01 deferred to WP-11 importer.

requirements.title: Observable bookkeeping
requirements.contract: Read/access/feedback side effects visible in the compatibility contract are not silently made eventually consistent.
requirements.evidence: RQ-17 read side effects persisted via canonical gateway before success: memory_read applies Access (confidence +0.015, access_count+1, last_accessed_at, context tag) in repository_internal.rs apply_access / interpreter.rs; semantic_search does not boost (upstream). Feedback: positive +0.015 + access_count + positive_feedback++, negative -0.02 + negative_hits++ + negative_feedback++. Tests: tools.rs memory_read_records_access_side_effect, memory_feedback_positive_boosts_confidence, memory_feedback_negative_reduces_confidence.

requirements.title: Durability qualification
requirements.contract: A durable ACK includes required storage barriers; process-crash and power-loss qualifications remain distinct.
requirements.evidence: T-REC-01: kill/reopen durability probes pass (fjall SyncAll + lance). T-REC-03 I/O fault injection and T-BENCH-01 benchmark deferred.

requirements.title: Safe recovery and restore
requirements.contract: A verified snapshot is restored through a coordinated generation switch; confirmation is digest/state/channel-bound and single use.

requirements.title: Local security boundary
requirements.contract: Only approved same-user frontends connect; inputs, paths, resource limits and dynamic context are treated as untrusted data.
requirements.evidence: Same-UID peer-credential check before any frame (pair-tested), past-deadline refusal, handshake validation, bounded frames, per-frame frontend binding (frontend_mismatch rejection), WireReply shape fix (rejections parseable). Full adversarial suites (fuzzing, 32-startup arbitration, malicious-archive/visualizer vectors) deferred.

requirements.title: Auditable distribution
requirements.contract: The CPU release requires no Python/Node/ONNX or C++ database engine; native exceptions and model rights are explicitly audited.

requirements.title: Bounded concurrency
requirements.contract: Queues, snapshots, inference, maintenance and per-client load have bounded resources and documented overload behavior.
requirements.evidence: Bounded embedding worker (queue depth, batch accounting, cancel, stats) with async service bridge (Busy maps to retryable busy:); quotas wired end-to-end (client register/unregister lifecycle, per-client queue, in-flight storage, response byte budget — all with backpressure tests); idle-exit mode; sequential maintenance passes. Saturation benchmarks and fairness-under-load measurement deferred to WP-12.

requirements.title: Reproducible benchmarks
requirements.contract: Performance comparisons use equivalent guarantees, realistic traces, declared hardware and reproducible raw measurements.

requirements.title: Measured retrieval quality
requirements.contract: Quality is judged at fixed result/context budgets on held-out labels, including multilingual, conflict, stale and no-answer cases.

requirements.title: Skill and host conformance
requirements.contract: Skill ownership, installation, discovery and workflow activation are distinct tests; foreign assets remain untouched.

requirements.title: Coherent import
requirements.contract: The importer reads a coherent supported source snapshot, handles references explicitly, reports every loss, and does not modify the original source.

requirements.title: Incremental delivery
requirements.contract: Each slice has an end-to-end demonstration and regression evidence; no placeholder handler counts as implemented compatibility.

requirements.title: Evidence discipline
requirements.contract: Planned, inspected, executed, passed, failed and waived statuses are never conflated; unrun benchmarks carry no invented values.
